The '''Raid on [[Spacestation 1138]]''' was an attempt made by [[Nym/Legends|Nym]], leader of the [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]], to rescue [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]], [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Orsai]] in particular, on board the infamous [[Prison/Legends|prison]] called [[Spacestation 1138]].

==Prelude==
The pirate band [[Lok Revenants/Legends|Lok Revenants]] was engaged in a struggle against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] for control of the [[Karthakk system]]. After joining forces with the [[Revenant (Mere)|Revenants]], [[Nym/Legends|Nym]] agreed to rescue prisoners. But first they had to find them in a raid on a Federation base. After learning the location of the infamous space station, they set a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|course]] for it.

==The battle==
The strike force arrived with codes stolen from a Trade Federation outpost on [[Maramere]]. [[Jinkins]] entered the codes into the station, allowing Captain [[Orsai]] and his crew to escape and break into an armory. Meanwhile, Nym, [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] and the others destroyed the station's anti-starship and anti-starfighter [[Laser turret/Legends|laser turrets]] because the [[Liberator (Mere)|''Liberator'']], piloted by [[Kole]], could not approach without being targeted by the defenses. The station attempted to destroy the ''Liberator'' by sending [[Scarab-class starfighter/Legends|Scarab starfighters]] and [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Droid starfighters]].

Jinkins' codes unwittingly activated a number of [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]]s that subsequently pinned down Orsai and his men. Orsai told Nym to destroy the [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] door to send them flying into space. Nym complied, and the droids were blown out of the hangar.

When the rest of the station's defense was eliminated, the Trade Federation sent [[Trade Federation Troop Transport|troop transports]] with [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighter]] escort to reinforce the station. Despite the fighter escort, the [[Troop transport/Legends|troop transports]] were all destroyed one by one before they could dock.

Orsai then met some [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidian]] support staff who attempted to stall the prisoners. The Neimoidians, however, weren't brave enough to risk their own lives and didn't put up much resistance. Eventually, the prisoners got onto the ''Liberator'', and with a friendly starfighter escort the ''Liberator'' escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Aftermath==
Although the mission was a success, Adi Gallia knew with the [[Trade Federation sensor station]] still online they would be soon be under attack again. Jinkins calculated two probable locations for it, and Nym decided to go for the nearest one to search for and if necessary [[Attack on the Trade Federation Sensor Station|destroy it]].

==Behind the scenes==
This article was created based on the mission "Prison Break" in the video game ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Starfighter]]''. The name of the station itself is yet another reference to ''[[TK-421/Legends|THX 1138]]''.
